decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform sits at the core of the firm's established knowledge base and reusable architectures, so the firm can interpret customer feedback and keep improving it through its own R&D and platform partnerships.
Mobile field data capture builds closely on the firm's GIS and mobile competences and had a page of its own in both years, but mobile components were pruned before, which leaves moderate risk.

The search extension is being actively versioned (1.6.0), which shows the firm is absorbing user learning and applying it to its core map.apps ecosystem, unlike the smaller plugins it dropped earlier.
